P0000.rationale: 49 CFR 392.10(a) establishes a mandatory stopping duty before crossing railroad tracks at grade, explicitly conditioned by '[e]xcept as provided in paragraph (b) of this section.' Paragraph (b)(1) specifies that a stop need not be made at a streetcar crossing or industrial switching tracks within a business district. Setting relation to 'exception' and qualifying C0000 accurately converts this prose caveat into an explicit qualification edge targeting the stopping duty baseline while preserving the correct 'not_required' modality.
